title: S-Lib
description: A core utility library providing shared code for Stalemated's mods.
body:
**S-Lib is a shared library containing common utilities, helpers, and APIs for Stalemated's Minecraft mods.** 

It provides no content by itself and is strictly a dependency required to run projects like [Custom Tooltip API](https://modrinth.com/mod/custom-tooltip-api) and Smart Tooltip Scroll.

Feel free to use it in your projects if you feel like it fits your needs.
